# Best MagSafe car mounts (Qi2)

**Best for most iPhone owners: Belkin BoostCharge Qi2 15W Vent Mount (~$47.99)**
- Three reviews pick it as the sensible all-rounder. It charges at up to 15W and includes a 27W car adapter and a USB-C cable. It rotates between portrait and landscape.
- Vent fit matters: Belkin specifies slats up to 3 mm thick and 20 mm deep. Straight horizontal slats work best, and vertical ones can droop.
- Sources: [RottenWiFi](https://rottenwifi.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/), [iTechGuides](https://www.itechguides.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/)
- Belkin also makes a vent/dash version for cars with awkward vents.

**Best for fast charging and reliability: Anker Prime MagGo AirCool (Qi2 25W, $89.99 list)**
- It has thermoelectric cooling plus a fan, which helps when navigation and sun heat up the phone. Mount Guys uses it daily and calls it their best overall. [Mount Guys](https://www.mountguys.com/best-magsafe-car-mount/)
- Gadgeteer listed it at $69.99 (discounted from $89.99), so check the current price. [The Gadgeteer](https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/)
- It's not compatible with Tesla or Mercedes-Benz vehicles, or cars with nonstandard vents.
- Only iPhone 16 Pro Max/Plus and iPhone 17 get the full 25W. Older iPhones top out around 15W, so it's overkill for them.
- Sources disagree on the adapter. Two say a 60W adapter is included, while RottenWiFi says you need a 45W+ adapter. Confirm what's in the box before buying.

**Best value with a fan: ESR HaloLock Qi2 15W with CryoBoost**
- It's a Qi2-certified 15W mount with a cooling fan, and it works on a vent or the dash.
- Prices vary by source. Gadgeteer lists $18.99 with no adapter included. Dealectric shows a $39.99 store price, or about $32.80 with code PARTNER18 (it says that code expires 2026-12-31).
- Buy from ESR's store (affiliate link, Dealectric earns a commission): [ESR HaloLock CryoBoost](https://dealectric.com/go/esr-halolock-15w-wireless-car-charger-cryoboost)

**Other options**
- **LISEN Qi2.2 25W with cooling fan (from $39.95):** Gadgeteer's top pick, with a 95W adapter included. It only hits 25W with the fan on. [The Gadgeteer](https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/)
- **Non-charging option, VICSEED steel-core vent mount:** a simple, sturdy backup if you don't want a cable. Mount Guys researched it but didn't test it. [Mount Guys](https://www.mountguys.com/best-magsafe-car-mount/)
- **Trucks and rough roads:** Mount Guys suggests the RAM bolt-down mount.

**Buying tips**
- Look for the Qi2 badge. "MagSafe-compatible" alone may mean slow 7.5W charging.
- Check your car's vents first. If they're thin, angled or vertical, choose a dash or suction mount.
- Fast charging needs a strong USB-C car adapter. Don't rely on the car's built-in USB-A port.
- Passive mounts can throttle on hot dashboards. Fan-cooled models like the Anker, ESR CryoBoost and LISEN avoid this.

The search results didn't include direct Amazon product URLs, so the Belkin, Anker and LISEN links go to the reviews with buy buttons. Tell me your phone model and car, and I can narrow it down to one pick.
